Sometimes you see a product with great reviews, then you buy it and isna dissapointment but not this one, with less than 5 minutes I noticed my hair less brassy and color almost white. The product wasn’t as expected. My hair was pretty blonde and it never got silver. It was only until I had it bleached a crazy white color, that it got silver hues. Also it is NOT sulfate free. The back clearly states sulfates.

Amazing Product!! I love it. They send you a pair of gloves with the shampoo.. but i for got to wear them LOL I end up with a little purple nails :D that’s how concentrated the product is, Careful with white tile bathrooms!

If you're going for a true platinum finish and you haven't obtained it yet, there's some things you need to know. This bottle advertises that you'll be able to OBTAIN a platinum look with it, but I'm skeptical. I followed all the instructions carefully. After bleaching (twice), I obtained the lightness I was looking for but still had the brass, naturally. I rested my hair and hydrated it. Two days later, I applied this product to wet hair with gloves and rinsed after 2 minutes (per instructions)

I love this product! After one wash my balayage was icy white again. I have very stubborn asian hair that goes bronze quickly and have tried similar products that were more expensive and this one works best by far. Just pair it with a good conditioner and you're golden!

reviews.t: Totally love it while transitioning to grey!
reviews.x: I'm transitioning to grey, but still have some brassy tones from lightening my dark brown hair to blonde.  This product is so much stronger than regular purple shampoo, and it's completely neutralized those brassy tones to a grey color.  I've been using this product since I started my transition last May.  That's one year ago, and I'll continue using it when my hair is completely grey to keep it a cool fresh color.

I was hesitant to try purple shampoo but I wanted to bleach my hair and have it not be yellow or some other brassy shade. Initially when I tried this product, I only did about 2 minutes and was afraid to go longer because I didn’t want my hair to turn purple...needless to say, I wasn’t very happy with my result on the first try. I wanted a couple of months and tried again. This time I went with 6 minutes of leaving the shampoo in my hair. When I saw it in the mirror, I was extremely happy with w

reviews.t: Works wonders on my thin short silver hair
reviews.x: I used this, this evening. It lightened my hair to an almost white. 💯 happy with the results. The smell is mild enough I didn’t really notice it at all. I did use a reconstructing conditioner right after using this shampoo, my hair is soft. If your goal is to lighten the brassy color out of your hair THIS IS IT. I have thin short hair Tomorrow I will apply only to my roots where the brassy almost orange is because of my toner, and will update then.

I purchased this product as I color my hair blonde and it tends to get brassy in the summer. After receiving it, I got this email saying how to use it, and making it sound like it would really alter my hair color, turning it silver, and so I didn't use it. Yesterday (weeks later), I got an email asking me to review it, so today I decided to try it. I opened the box and the bottle was sealed in plastic and taped. There were gloves with it. I was even more nervous! LOL. I gave my hair a quick wash
Me encanto el shampoo llego perfectamente bien

For $20, I would not repurchase this. The bottle is very small and for that amount of product, I would not recommend this. The first application resulted in lightening the blonde in my hair (originally dark brown) but the second did not work as well. I kept the product in for approximately the maximum recommended amount of time. The second time, I did not notice any lightening. Both times, my hair was more dry, especially the second time. The shampoo does not cleanse at all, and is purely for th

This product is AMAZING. I constantly get told I dyed my hair when I have only been using this product! I have dirty blonde hair and I love the silver look, if you are trying to get a platinum/silver look, you’ll have to deal with some purple hues, which I think look pretty cute if you ask me! Does dry out the hair a little but make sure to use a good conditioner or use a different shampoo every once in awhile.

It's OK, but that's all I can say. It sort of works, but doesn't do a great job no matter how long I leave it in. Bought the purple hair mask too, even using both gets a so-so result on extremely bleach-blonde hair. (Mine isn't bleached all over, but I use the shampoo and mask all over. repeated applications still aren't really working)

This product is by far the Best purple shampoo i have used. It does what it says it will do and smells amazing! I love that it is sulfate free so you don't get that awful chemical smell. You do not need to leave in your hair very long to get results. This is my purple shampoo from now on☺

This shampoo beats out all the other purple shampoos I have tried, and I’ve tried a LOT! It’s a deep purple, smells so good, and takes the brass out. I use it to upkeep after using the B Uniq purple hair mask. Love these products and they’re my new go to!

Much better and stronger than other purple shampoo products I’ve used.  Works pretty fast so don’t need to leave it on long at all.  So far I love it.  People have been complimenting me thinking I just got my hair Re-Done.... Nope just my purple shampoo 😁

reviews.t: my hair will look like it was freshly colored
reviews.x: I’ve only used this once but, just after one use, I could tell the brassy color wasn’t as prominent. Im sure after using this a few times per week, my hair will look like it was freshly colored.
Awesome, if not the best shampoo if you really want to see results. And it does what it says without drying the hair out. Unfortunately it's expensive.

reviews.t: It does turn hands purple if not gloved.
reviews.x: Have been using for a week.  It helps highlight the silver tones in my blond silver hair.  Would give it 5 stars if it smelled better.
I love the product. If you’ll fallow the instruction you’ll have beautiful results, Platinum blonde color.
Product worked as promised and keeps the brassy tones out of the white blond color that I have.
It does leave a purple glow if you leave it on a bit long, but I love the glow, just love it

claims.text: Most reviewers find the shampoo highly effective at neutralizing brassiness and achieving ash, silver, or icy tones, often preferring it to other purple shampoos they've tried.
Several reviewers note the product is very concentrated and can stain, so gloves are recommended and care is needed with white surfaces.
A few reviewers report disappointment, saying it did not deliver the advertised platinum or silver result and that it is not sulfate-free.
Some reviewers mention the product can be drying and should be paired with a good conditioner.
A few reviewers comment on the smell, generally describing it as mild or not off-putting.
